notes.title: 死亡禁地2游戏史诗级变更...现彻底更替为全新游戏OMEGA卡牌冒险！！！
notes.notes: [p]A 3D version of the 'Kill Spire' strategy card game, with exquisite and delicate graphics and a strong atmosphere, far surpassing similar games. The gameplay retains the essence of card games while discarding complex and useless functions and systems. It is simple and easy to learn, without the need for players to spend time learning, researching, and strategizing. By matching cards that suit them, players can enjoy the game to the end. It's that simple.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102686/67a10c901684f1d6e983dfd5e789c2d75dc5a216.png"][/img]Feature[/p][p]Dynamically constructed deck: Choose your cards! Unlock nearly a hundred different cards during the challenge, choose whether to add them to your deck, and use combinations to unleash unexpected effects, defeat enemies, and challenge to the end.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102686/d27926959f38ac0757f446f32bd644496080f1dc.png"][/img]Different choices of maps: Each time the challenge begins, the map's route provides different choices. Should we choose high risk and high return, or proceed cautiously? Facing different enemies, choosing different cards, discovering different equipment, and dealing with random events![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102686/3496bb3a83dc458266b4d611290656148e20c84e.png"][/img]Powerful equipment: In the map, you will find various black technology equipment that will produce powerful chemical reactions with your deck, allowing your combat power to soar. But don't be too demanding, it may cost you more.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102686/61d7147126b78c9b93874e574aae07bbd7b56ff4.png"][/img]OMEGA Card Adventure has completed its pre release version and currently has the following content:[/p][p]6 characters, each with unique attributes.[/p][p]About 100 available cards.[/p][p]More than 10 types of functional equipment that can be found.[/p][p]More than 50 completely different battles.[/p][p]About 10 mysterious events that can bring you help or cause harm.[/p]

notes.title: Version Adjustment, Repair, and Update Announcement V0.1
notes.notes:
1. Adjust the initial game characters to "Cyberpunk" and "Scavenger".
2. Adjust and reduce the consumption of the character's physical system in task mode.
3. Adjust and increase the number of bullets dropped by enemies in mission mode.
4. Adjust and reduce the damage range after special airdrops hit the ground.
5. The issue of equipment and weapons not being synchronized after changing the character.
3. The problem of data synchronization not working properly after upgrading the role task.

notes.title: Announcement of Version Problem Repair and Update Plan
notes.notes:
（Version Adjustment, Repair, and Update Announcement V0.1
In order to match the normal configuration and run the game smoothly, the default image quality will be adjusted to the lowest setting. High demand players can modify their own configuration in the game settings.
2. Adjust the initial game characters to "Cyberpunk" and "Scavenger".
3. Adjust and reduce the consumption of the character's physical system in task mode.
4. Adjust and increase the number of bullets dropped by enemies in mission mode.
5. Adjust and reduce the damage range after special airdrops hit the ground.）


（Plan Version Adjustment, Repair, and Update Announcement V0.2
1. The issue of equipment and weapons not being synchronized after changing the character.
2. There is an issue where the model accessories cannot be displayed after upgrading the weapon.
3. The problem of data synchronization not working properly after upgrading the role task.）


（Plan version adjustment, repair, and update announcement V0.3
1. Fix the problem where the equipment grenade cannot switch to a firearm normally under special circumstances after use.
2. Fix the issue where firearms cannot be switched normally under special circumstances after using the phone.
3. Fix the issue where the map does not display the marked location after using the mobile GPS positioning function.）
